## Summary

- M & N Properties (UK) Ltd (company number 04320630) is an active private limited company incorporated on 2001-11-12, some 298.6 months ago, operating under SIC code 68100. It is run by 3 active officers out of 5 ever appointed, with no new appointments in the last 12 months. `[profile; officers; computed]`
- The company has one outstanding charge (043206300010), created 2015-01-19 in favour of Coutts & Company, a third-party lender; under SEC-01 no first-charge facility can be offered and any new facility would rank as a second charge unless that charge is redeemed at completion. `[043206300010; SEC-01]`
- That outstanding charge contains both fixed and floating elements and a negative pledge: SEC-08 requires referral to establish what unencumbered assets remain behind the floating charge, and SEC-07 requires Coutts' written consent to be evidenced before any facility is offered. `[043206300010; SEC-07; SEC-08]`
- A further nine charges, all to Coutts & Company / Coutts and Company, are recorded as fully satisfied, including six created on the same day (2010-08-02); SEC-06 treats such clustered charges to one lender as a structured or tranched facility, so full redemption figures for all charges are needed before any refinance is quoted. `[created 2010-08-02 · Coutts & Company; created 2010-08-02 · Coutts & Company #2; created 2010-08-02 · Coutts & Company #3; created 2010-08-02 · Coutts & Company #4; created 2010-08-02 · Coutts & Company #5; created 2010-08-02 · Coutts & Company #6; created 2010-08-02 · Coutts and Company; created 2011-10-30 · Coutts and Company; created 2012-08-01 · Coutts and Company; SEC-06]`
- Filing conduct is strong: accounts have been filed ahead of deadline every year since 2004, with the latest accounts (made up to 2025-11-30) filed on 2026-02-09 some 200 days early, and nothing is overdue with the next accounts not due until 2027-08-31. `[AA filed 2026-02-09; AA filed 2025-04-01; AA filed 2004-03-15; profile]`
- However, the accounts are filed on a total-exemption basis and so disclose no turnover or profit; CON-04 requires management accounts covering the most recent 12 months before a lending decision can be taken. `[AA filed 2026-02-09; profile; CON-04]`
- Practical approach: the file must go to REFER, and the RM should ask the directors for 12 months of management accounts, Coutts redemption figures across all charges, and written consent to a further charge before any terms are indicated. `[CON-04; SEC-01; SEC-06; SEC-07; SEC-08]`
